hazards.name: High-speed roadway design
hazards.description: The presence of multiple wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures encourages high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands visible, making it dangerous to cross the wide arterial road.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long white fence along the property line limits visibility between the sidewalk and the residential property, reducing passive surveillance.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible in the immediate vicinity, which may impact pedestrian safety and security at night.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction

hazards.name: Narrow unbuffered sidewalk

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow them to slow traffic and provide space for other modes like protected bike lanes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages, reducing exposure to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility patterns and signage to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to ensure the walkway is well-lit at night, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Street Tree Infill
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees within the grass buffer to provide shade and create a more comfortable pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps and Tactile Pavings
interventions.description: Provide ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to ensure the sidewalk network is accessible.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during non-daylight hours.

interventions.title: Enhanced Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway with vertical elements or landscaping to increase pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage more transparent fencing or landscaping instead of a solid wall to improve sightlines and passive surveillance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe walking path.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility markings and pedestrian warning signage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing walkway to at least 6 feet and provide a landscaped buffer or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct raised, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Access Management
interventions.description: Define specific driveway entrances for the gas station using curbs and sidewalks to reduce the width of vehicle conflict zones.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads at the signalized intersection ahead.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths or the number of lanes to slow traffic and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface or replace the cracked concrete slabs to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Install a Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for a wider sidewalk or bike lane.

interventions.title: Relocate Obstructions
interventions.description: Move signage and utility poles out of the clear walking path to ensure the sidewalk meets ADA accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of vehicle access points to the minimum necessary for safe entry/exit, restoring the curb and a dedicated sidewalk path.

interventions.title: Install Vertical Delineators or Bollards
interventions.description: Place physical barriers between the sidewalk area and the vehicle maneuvering area to clearly define and protect the pedestrian space.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Apply clear, high-contrast markings across the driveway areas to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk supplemented with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase the distance between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially supplemented with a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) given the road width.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access points to the minimum necessary, restoring the curb and sidewalk across the majority of the frontage.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk across the property frontage to provide a clear, protected path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Landscape Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or bollards between the new sidewalk and the gas station lot to prevent vehicle encroachment and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a raised curb and a planting or furniture buffer to clearly separate the pedestrian walkway from the commercial apron and roadway.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement and widen the walkway to meet modern accessibility standards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Islands
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian refuge islands to reduce crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or 'neck-downs' to tighten turn radii and slow down vehicles entering commercial areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, buffered sidewalk network with clear separation from the roadway and consistent ADA-compliant curb ramps.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with flashing beacons to improve driver awareness and yielding.

interventions.title: Clear Walkway Policy
interventions.description: Relocate temporary signage and construction equipment to the shoulder or a designated furniture zone to ensure a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge islands
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Delineated Walkway
interventions.description: Mark a clear pedestrian path through the parking lot with paint or physical barriers to separate people from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Marking
interventions.description: Reduce the width and number of driveways, and use high-visibility markings to indicate pedestrian priority across vehicle access points.

interventions.title: Walkway Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Relocate obstructions like planters to the furniture zone and repair degraded pavement to ensure a smooth, accessible path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Apply continental or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly delineate the crossing area.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility of the crossing and sidewalk at night.
